column1: # design/dpat-admission.tsv — the KNOWN schema-pattern debt that enters the census with its reason.
# `design/dpat-baseline.tsv` is the frozen census: it may only shrink. New known debt — a shape an
# upstream pin brings in that cannot be retired yet — enters HERE instead, one row per
# (file, rule, symbol) with the same COUNT as a census row plus two columns the census does not
# have: WHY it cannot be retired, and the ISSUE that retires it (DESIGN.md A.11).
# `scripts/design-dpat.sh` merges this file into the census. It refuses a row with no why or no
# issue, a key that also lives in the baseline (one row, one home), and an admission the tree no
# longer needs. An admitted row is reported as known like any other, and this file's issues are
# printed with the run's summary, so the debt and its owner are on the record.
# Columns: file, rule, symbol, count, why, issue.
